name: dev-servers
description: A Servers pane for this project's dev servers: what is listening, on which port, since when, with Start, Stop, Restart and Log buttons; names the process holding a port when a command fails with EADDRINUSE; a read-only dev_servers tool for Claude. Scans with netstat (never lsof), one session for all; no model calls.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often listening ports are re-read (netstat; ps and lsof once per new pid). One open session scans for all of them, a slow scan doubles the interval up to 5 minutes, and nothing is started or stopped on a timer.

logDir.title: Log folder
logDir.description: Where servers started from the pane write their output, one folder per project.

stopGraceSeconds.title: Stop grace (seconds)
stopGraceSeconds.description: How long Stop waits after SIGTERM before saying the server is still running. SIGKILL is only sent when Stop is pressed a second time.
